description: Copy verified scalar effect-property values from one effect to the matching effect on another clip. Both clips must already have the same effect applied. Legacy CEP deliberately refuses Blend Mode because Premiere can corrupt its enum value on cross-clip writes.

effect_name.description: Display name of the effect to copy values for

source_node_id.description: Node ID of the source clip

target_node_id.description: Node ID of the target clip

name: copy_effect_values

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Copy Effect Values
